AI Overview
Coreball is a minimalist, browser-based timing and skill game inspired by the classic 2015 game AA Ball. 
Internet Computer Developer Forum
 +1
How It Works
Objective: Launch a queue of small balls (or pins) one by one onto a spinning central core.
Rule: You must attach every ball without hitting any of the other balls or pins already stuck to the core.
Controls: Click or tap anywhere on the screen to fire a ball straight upward toward the center.
Difficulty: As you advance, the core changes rotation speed, reverses direction, or speeds up, requiring you to time your shots ahead of the gap rather than reacting to it live.

Key Details
Platform: Free to play directly in a web browser on desktop, laptop, tablet, or mobile devices with no download required.
Levels: Originally launched with 60 levels, the game has expanded over time to include 500 levels.
